findings.title: The supplemented audit does not prove that the partial receipt came from its tested admission/input
findings.scope: Qualification certification for both native v2 partial receipts and accepted model-compatible v1 partial evidence; propagated scientific admission on authorized seeds17/29/43.
findings.source_evidence: certify reads the partial receipt and the audit tested admission separately. Its partial require checks flags, backbone, family, environment and eight model hashes. It never compares partial.admission, partial.input_identity, partial.preprocessing or partial.source_seal with audit.tested_admission/tested_seed17_input/tested_preprocessing/tested_source_seal. The v2 receipt emits these bindings. The audit binding checks alone do not close the missing partial-to-tested-run edge.
findings.consequence: A successful partial receipt from a different exact role/label pack or configuration of the same graph/family/runtime/model can accompany an audit for the declared seed17 case. Descriptors prove byte identity of each artifact but not that they describe the same attempted run. This is a source admission gap; no such mismatch or numerical failure was observed.
findings.smallest_repair: For modern-teacher-partial-qualification-v2, validate the schema and emitted admission/input_identity/preprocessing/source_seal against the audited tested admission/input/preprocessing/source seal before issuing a certificate. For legitimate v1 evidence lacking those fields, require a typed legacy binding chain (original teacher admission/request, actual teacher cell freeze and terminal binding request/receipt hashes, actual preprocessing evidence), verify descriptors and cross-links, and prove exact tested role/label/config/source identity. Do not require rerunning compatible numerical evidence or invent missing v1 fields.

findings.title: Scientific correction consumes replay logits without rejecting disagreement with the selected saved logits
findings.scope: Scientific correction fit for a selected frozen teacher checkpoint; short qualification replay is separately asserted and does not provide an assertion for each later scientific checkpoint.
findings.source_evidence: The scientific correction path restores a checkpoint, computes actual logits, loads the selected saved logits, computes replay_difference and writes its maximum. It then prepares inputs from the actual replay logits. No shape/dtype/finite/frozen-tolerance comparison gates that continuation. restore_teacher checks metadata and state loading but does not compare outputs to the saved reference. The explicit assert_close in modern_teacher_driver is conditional on qualify.
findings.consequence: Finite replay logits differing beyond the frozen logit tolerance can still become the correction teacher and receive a successful terminal/SCORE_FREEZE. The strict replay check on a short qualification checkpoint does not establish parity of every subsequently selected scientific checkpoint. This is a missing source gate, not evidence that replay currently fails.
findings.smallest_repair: Add a driver-only comparison before correction input preparation: require exact reference shape/dtype and finite values, assert the actual replay logits against the selected saved FP32 logits at frozen rtol1e-5/atol1e-6, retain the difference receipt and charge its transfers/check cost. Propagate failure through the existing correction terminal ledger. Keep the native model, full schedules, primary raw mean-logit pooling and tolerance unchanged.
